description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Donnie & April.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Donnie & April from exile to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
